speaker: GRANDMA
text:
Happy birthday, love!!

I remember the day you were born like it was yesterday. Your mom and dad were over the moon.

speaker: GRANDMA
text:
I'm so sorry love. If only your parents were still here to celebrate with us...

But you are right, enough with the crying. I've got something for you now that you are 18. Look at this, what do you think?

I'm giving you my car!

speaker: GRANDMA
text:
Yes, love, it's yours now.

Could you stop by [POI] on [STREET] and pick up some maple syrup?
I'll make you pancakes this afternoon.
